messages:
Maria (CS): FYI BrightFarm just escalated — they say they got a dunning notice and were suspended but they have an enterprise PO on file. Invoice INV-2024-321 / acct BF-798. Can someone check?
Alan (Billing): On it. Quick look: INV-2024-321 shows unpaid. Payment attempts: card declined. I also see PO BF-PO-901 uploaded 2024-11-12 but status = unlinked in Billing UI.
Sarah (Support): Customer says they emailed the PO to acct@billing and got an automated receipt. They’re on a call and say suspension happened during work hours — super disruptive.
Javier (Finance Ops): Collections automation triggered suspend at 03:05 UTC after the 3rd dunning notice. It’s an automated flow. We can do a manual unsuspend after review, but we should make sure PO is actually linked and any credits applied.
Maria (CS): :eyes: Can we get a manual unsuspend ASAP? They need immediate access. If needed we can mark as 'appeal' while we reconcile.
Alan (Billing): I can link PO but need a quick confirm: PO number BF-PO-901 matches billing legal entity? If yes, steps I'll run: 1) attach PO to account in Billing UI 2) apply credit memos to invoices (if PO covers them) 3) clear dunning flags. CLI examples below:
```bash
billing-cli apply-po --account BF-798 --po BF-PO-901
billing-cli credit --invoice INV-2024-321 --amount 12450 --reason 'PO applied'
```
Sarah (Support): On the call — customer re-sent the PO PDF to me. Uploading to the portal now and forwarding to billing.
collections-bot: Auto-suspend: account BF-798 suspended due to DUNNING_THRESHOLD at 2024-11-30T03:05:12Z. Suspend ID: SUS-9821
Javier (Finance Ops): Once Alan applies credit, can someone run `/billing unsuspend BF-798 --temp`? I’ll approve the override so the automation doesn’t re-suspend immediately.
Alan (Billing): Done — PO linked and credit applied. CLI output: 
```text
PO BF-PO-901 linked to BF-798
Credit memos created: CM-5567 ($12,450)
Invoice INV-2024-321 status -> PAID_BY_CREDIT
```
collections-bot: Unsuspend command executed by javier: `/billing unsuspend --account BF-798 --reason 'collections appeal'`. Account BF-798 unsuspended. Collections queue note: SUS-9821 -> resolved pending reconciliation.
Maria (CS): Customer confirmed service restored. They requested written confirmation that account won’t be auto-suspended again while PO processing is in flight.
Javier (Finance Ops): I’ll add a temporary flag `collections_hold` for 7 days and create a follow-up to reconcile the PO mapping with invoices. Also verifying PO terms vs billing entity with legal.
Alan (Billing): Flag set. Logged FIN-3456 to reconcile PO -> invoice mapping and prevent future auto-suspends when a PO is uploaded but not linked.
Sarah (Support): I’ll send the confirmation email to the customer with CM-5567 and the PO attached, and close the support ticket. :white_check_mark:
